templates.name: Outline
templates.description: Collaborative knowledge base with PostgreSQL, Valkey and local file storage.
templates.notes: Requires an existing OIDC provider and a registered client; use the real provider authorization/token/userinfo URLs and set its callback to https://YOUR_DOMAIN/auth/oidc.callback. Synthetic local readiness does not validate provider login. Preserve SECRET_KEY and UTILS_SECRET with backups; configure SMTP for email workflows. Cove resource figures are starter sizing floors, not application-capacity guarantees; size and back up for your workload.
templates.compose:
services:
  outline:
    image: docker.getoutline.com/outlinewiki/outline:1.13.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - storage:/var/lib/outline/data
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      URL: ${APP_URL:?Set APP_URL}
      PORT: '3000'
      SECRET_KEY: ${APP_SECRET:?Set APP_SECRET}
      UTILS_SECRET: ${UTILS_SECRET:?Set UTILS_SECRET}
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://outline:${DATABASE_PASSWORD:?Set DATABASE_PASSWORD}@db:5432/outline
      PGSSLMODE: disable
      REDIS_URL: redis://:${CACHE_PASSWORD:?Set CACHE_PASSWORD}@cache:6379/0
      FILE_STORAGE: local
      FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_DIR: /var/lib/outline/data
      FORCE_HTTPS: 'true'
      OIDC_USERNAME_CLAIM: preferred_username
      OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME: OpenID Connect
      OIDC_SCOPES: openid profile email
      OIDC_CLIENT_ID: ${OIDC_CLIENT_ID:?Set OIDC_CLIENT_ID}
      OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET: ${OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET:?Set OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET}
      OIDC_AUTH_URI: ${OIDC_AUTH_URI:?Set OIDC_AUTH_URI}
      OIDC_TOKEN_URI: ${OIDC_TOKEN_URI:?Set OIDC_TOKEN_URI}
      OIDC_USERINFO_URI: ${OIDC_USERINFO_URI:?Set OIDC_USERINFO_URI}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - node
      - -e
      - fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/',{redirect:'manual'}).then(r=>process.exit(r.status>=200&&r.status<400?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      cache:
        condition: service_healthy
  db:
    image: postgres:18.7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - database:/var/lib/postgresql
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: outline
      POSTGRES_USER: outline
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:?Set DATABASE_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U "$${POSTGRES_USER}" -d "$${POSTGRES_DB}"
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
  cache:
    image: valkey/valkey:9.2.0-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - cache:/data
    environment:
      CACHE_PASSWORD: ${CACHE_PASSWORD:?Set CACHE_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - valkey-cli -a "$${CACHE_PASSWORD}" ping | grep -q PONG
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 20s
    command:
    - valkey-server
    - --appendonly
    - 'yes'
    - --requirepass
    - ${CACHE_PASSWORD:?Set CACHE_PASSWORD}
volumes:
  storage: {}
  database: {}
  cache: {}
